verdict.rationale: Grafana supports ad-hoc exploratory queries (grafana-gh-1). Loki indexes only label metadata and stores log content in chunks (grafana-docs-35, grafana-docs-55), while LogQL filters with labels and operators (grafana-docs-15), which suggests some filtering on unindexed content. Tempo trace search (grafana-docs-4) adds another ad-hoc query path, but nothing shows group-by on high-cardinality fields like user or request id without labels or aggregation set up first. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of group-by on high-cardinality fields, evidence that filtering on unindexed fields works at scale without predefined labels, documentation of how high-cardinality fields are handled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
